note: Normal ODIR fundus photographs relabelled as the healthy class of the frozen fundus_toxo_binary adapter. Sampling is by whole patient group, but the read-out is an image-level false-positive rate, not patient-isolated validation and not an external sensitivity claim. ODIR 'N' means the eight ODIR target diseases are absent; it is not a guarantee of a pathology-free eye. These rows are consumed by the single probe evaluation.
